title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues concerning Conviction and Sentencing in Criminal Cases Involving Guns Powered by Compressed Gas and Air Gun Pellets

articles.content_en: 1. With respect to the conduct of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, mailing, storing, possessing, privately keeping, or smuggling firearms powered by compressed gas and having relatively low muzzle specific kinetic energy, when deciding whether to investigate criminal liability and how to determine the penalty, not only shall the quantity of the firearms involved be considered, but also full consideration shall be given to factors such as the appearance, material, projectile, place and channel of purchase, price, purpose, degree of injurious capacity, whether it is easy to enhance the injurious capacity through modification, as well as the actor's subjective awareness, motive and purpose, usual conduct, illegal gains, whether to circumvent investigation, and other circumstances, so as to comprehensively assess the degree of social harm, adhere to the unity of subjective and objective aspects, and ensure that the crime, liability, and punishment are proportionate.

2. With respect to the conduct of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, mailing, storing, possessing, privately keeping, or smuggling lead pellets for air guns, when deciding whether to investigate criminal liability and how to determine the penalty, comprehensive consideration shall be given to factors such as the quantity of lead pellets, their purpose, and the actor's motive and purpose, usual conduct, illegal gains, whether to circumvent investigation, and other circumstances, so as to comprehensively assess the degree of social harm, and ensure that the crime, liability, and punishment are proportionate.
This is the reply.
